goal: Beyond cosmetic upscaling: director-selected documentary keyframes, 1080p color photo holds, visually impressive with honest limitations

editorial_selection.titles: only opening; no repeated graphics obstructing photograph

order: authentic archival frame at exact freeze instant
gentle monochrome denoise without obliterating grain
safe subject-centred crop at original resolution, no pre-AI downscale
Real-ESRGAN x4 restoration from native crop
resize 1080x1920, restrained contrast, no aggressive detailEnhance
manual compare crop-source vs restored photo
separate_models_optional: SUPIR with authorized GPU only, check rights
DiffBIR with authorized GPU only, verify pretrained weight licensing
GFPGAN/CodeFormer face-only if source face enough pixels, check identity
restoration.honest_quality_limit: AI can enhance but cannot recover truly missing features from 720x576 source

output.platform: H264/AAC, original music, ZIP+cover+4 posts+source rights
